snippet.title: Train Yard Builder – Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Choo-choo! On September 16, jump in and dive into the world of virtual mock-ups and create your dream model railroad! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674900/Train_Yard_Builder

Train Yard Builder has a great set of features:
– You'll love being able to create professional mock-ups! You can use workbenches of different dimensions and terrain configurations to craft unique projects.
– You can even create dioramas to use as home decorations or as part of larger projects!
– You can also display your mock-ups and dioramas in the Museum. You'll earn rewards and see how your projects look as museum exhibits!

Join our official Frozen Way Discord to become a member of our amazing community!
- Have access to exclusive content from our games!
